operation.summary: Read the spend journal of a namespace: entries of the current epoch (or another) in order, as entry/1. It answers from the device, with or without a network

query.name: namespace
query.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported

query.name: epoch
query.description: A journal epoch id; default the current one

operation.returns: epoch, epochs[], head{seq, hash, origin}, entries[entry/1], next_after, more, read_at

namespace.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported

epoch.description: A journal epoch id; default the current one
